text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both gaining modestly with ETH slightly outpacing BTC, suggesting some rotation into altseason positioning despite an overall fearful sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 28 indicates investors remain cautious, though the 2-point weekly improvement hints at stabilizing bearish pressure. BTC dominance holding at 56.5% with only $38B in daily volume reflects subdued conviction across the market—neither strong accumulation nor capitulation is evident.
